narrative.overview:
The site is a glazed wall from Samarkand's Registan. Facts are laid like tiles: square, hard-edged, flat-coloured, set in grout. Cobalt, lapis, turquoise and gold lustre sit on a white glaze ground. The eight-point star-and-cross tile is the one repeating motif, and it appears as a canvas wall, a thin border band, a faint field behind light sections, and small markers.

Density is generous and confident. Headlines are heavy, width-condensed and tight; body copy is quiet and readable. Surfaces are flat colour blocks with no soft shadows, and depth comes from tone steps between lapis, cobalt and glaze. Gold is the only action colour and is rare enough to be read as the next step.

The hero is a pointed niche (an iwan arch) with a gold double edge, set against the tile wall. Colour sections alternate between dark (lapis, cobalt) and light (glaze with a quiet tile field), each closed by the tile band.
keyCharacteristics: Palette of lapis, cobalt, turquoise and gold on white glaze; brick is declared but unused in the build.
One motif: the star-and-cross tile, in canvas, SVG band and field forms.
Square corners everywhere except the arched niche.
Sturdy display grotesk over a plain humanist body grotesk; no mono face.
Gold is the sole action colour; flat blocks, no blur shadows.
Motion is the tile wall (pointer warmth, resting sweep) plus small hover rotations; all of it has a still fallback.

rules.name: The One Lustre Rule
rules.body: Gold marks action and the single emphasis point on a surface. Never use it as a general decorative fill, and never put a second action colour beside it.

rules.name: The Glaze Ground Rule
rules.body: Light sections are glaze, never pure white, and carry the quiet tile field or a lapis rule. Dark sections are lapis or cobalt, never black.

rules.name: The Dark-Ground Pair Rule
rules.body: On lapis, cobalt and turquoise grounds text is white or lapis (turquoise and gold tiles take lapis text). Deep Gold is for light grounds only.

rules.name: The Sturdy Display Rule
rules.body: Every display and title element uses the font-display treatment (700). Never set a display face light, wide or italic.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are plain sentence-case text at readable size. Section headings are statements, not tagged labels above them.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: Numbers that sit in a column or a clock use tabular figures (the nav's Samarkand time).

rules.name: The Flat Glaze Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat colour. Separate them with tone, grout lines or the tile band; never with a blurred or offset shadow.

dos: Do use Gold Lustre (#e9b93a) for the one action on a surface, with lapis text.
Do build with square corners and flat colour blocks; use the tile motif for rules, markers and fields.
Do set every heading in the sturdy display treatment (700).
Do keep nav solid lapis, and give dark sections a tile band edge.
Do provide a static fallback for any motion; the wall draws once under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use Deep Gold for focus and tile accents on glaze, Gold Lustre on dark.
donts: Don't use blurred or offset drop shadows; use tone, grout or a zero-blur ring.
Don't introduce a second action colour or put gold on glaze as text.
Don't add a mono face, italic serif, tracked uppercase labels or kicker lines above headings.
Don't round buttons or panels; the arch is the only large curve.
Don't use black or pure white grounds.
